story-page.title: Learning since 2016.
story-page.description: I started coding in 2016 out of curiosity. Since then I've gone from freelancer to Frontend Lead, and I'm still learning.
story-page.2016-body: I wrote my first lines of code out of curiosity, years before anyone paid me for it.
story-page.2018-body: At 17 I took on my first clients. For three years I learned by shipping, including a school admin platform built with React, Nest.js and GraphQL.
story-page.2021-body: At 20 I joined my first team, and proposed moving our frontend to TypeScript.
story-page.2022-body: Promoted to Frontend Lead at 22. I made the stack calls, built shared templates and helped new developers ship their first work.
story-page.2023-body: I started learning Rust, and consolidated our frontend architecture: solid foundations, adapted to each type of project.
story-page.2024-body: I started learning to code with AI the right way: best practices and understanding every line, not vibe coding.
story-page.2025-body: Rust went from something I was learning to my day job: I started building our own microservices with it.
story-page.2026-body: fetchzen, my typed HTTP client on native Fetch, keeps growing on npm. And I'm far from finished: more to learn, more of my own projects and better work every year.
